decisions.reason: Locates the exact disabled expression; busy is AttachButton's useState local, unbound in AttachmentChips; explains empty occurrences return null before the map and plain-phase presence makes the left guard falsy, evaluating busy -> ReferenceError.
Explains the throw during render aborts the whole dock entry via the slot error boundary while the separate attach-button slot survives; diagnostic is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 expression to establish the bug is pre-existing, proposes a data-present plain-phase baseline mount and rollback/re-add isolation; grounds the diff's extra defects (hoisted status/record imageItem, inconsistent disabled hunk) and avoids overclaiming about historical users.
Removes the dangling busy reference preserving the phase guard, adds record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.(...) hardening, and scopes imageItem inside the callback where record/status exist.

Data-present plain-phase mount test asserting chip/remove exists, no boundary capture or console.error; explains empty-state tests miss the line and node --check cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component; requires the smoke in pre-ship gates.
